title: Placement test
subtitle: A short dialogue that estimates your current CEFR level.

intro.title: How it works
intro.description_one: The tutor asks you {{count}} question and adapts its difficulty to your answers.
intro.description_other: The tutor asks up to {{count}} questions and adapts their difficulty to your answers.
intro.duration: It takes about {{minutes}} minutes, and you can stop earlier at any moment.

steps.questions: Questions get easier or harder depending on how you answer.
steps.answers: Answer in your own words: a couple of sentences is enough.
steps.profile: The level you get is saved to the profile, and lessons are built around it.

intro.checking: Checking whether the language model is ready…
intro.configUnavailable: The server configuration is unavailable, so it is unknown whether the language model is ready. You can still try to start the test.

llmUnavailable.title: The language model is not configured
llmUnavailable.description: The placement test asks its questions through a language model. Set the provider address and the model name, then come back. {{where}}

chat.title: Placement dialogue
chat.question: Question {{number}}:
chat.thinking: The tutor is reading your answer and preparing the next question…
chat.allAnswered: All the questions are answered. Finish the test to see your level.

input.label: Your answer
input.placeholder: Answer in the language you learn
input.empty: Type an answer before sending it.
input.tooLong: An answer takes at most {{max}} characters.

result.title: Your level
result.saving: Saving the level to the profile…
result.savedToProfile: Level {{level}} is saved to the profile: lessons start from it.
result.notSavedToProfile: The level is not saved to the profile yet.
result.saveFailed: The level could not be saved to the profile.

errors.notConfigured: The language model is not configured, so the tutor cannot ask questions. Check the provider address and the model name. {{where}}
errors.upstreamUnavailable: The language model did not respond: usually it is stopped or busy with another request.
errors.upstreamError: The language model returned an error or an answer the application could not read.
errors.progressKept: The test is kept on the server: your answers are not lost, you can try again.
errors.startFailed: The placement test could not be started.
errors.restoreFailed: The unfinished test could not be loaded.
